finding.summary: The sample policy provider reparses and rebuilds recurring named policies.
finding.explanation: For every matching GetPolicyAsync call, the provider allocates a suffix with Substring, parses the same endpoint policy age, creates a new AuthorizationPolicyBuilder and requirement, and builds a new policy. The assigned IAuthorizationPolicyProvider uses a default AllowsCachingPolicies value of false, so AuthorizationMiddleware does not enable its endpoint policy cache for this provider. Repeated requests for a bounded policy name therefore repeat the parsing and construction work.
